name: Alaraz (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white triangle with its base along the fly and its apex at the hoist, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Alaraz (a mountain on red and chequy of blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Alaraz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
